title: System keeps crashing and deleting my data
body:
I just downloaded the app yesterday and since downloading i have had to create a new account and pet, 3 times because your server keeps deleting my data and asking me to rehatch my bird. So far my experience has been horrible because i simply cannot even access the app without a message showing that all my data has been deleted due to a corruption in your system.
So as a new user I can safely rate this app with 1 star.
